new: In December 1921 High Commissioner Herbert Samuel created the Supreme Muslim Council to manage Muslim endowments and sharia courts. Haj Amin al-Husayni, appointed Mufti of Jerusalem in 1921, was elected its president in January 1922. The British removed him from the council's presidency in 1937.
